bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Conceal
bridge_functions.description: Protect the window from capture while a screen holding a credential, a session token or pairing material is up

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Reveal
bridge_functions.description: Stop protecting for that screen. A backgrounded application is still protected

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.IsProtected
bridge_functions.description: Whether the window is protected from capture right now

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Authenticate
bridge_functions.description: Ask the device who this is, falling back to the passcode where biometry fails rather than to unlocked

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.CanAuthenticate
bridge_functions.description: Whether the device has a screen lock configured and can authenticate at all

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Telling.Show
bridge_functions.description: Show a notification now, or say why it was withheld

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Telling.Schedule
bridge_functions.description: Show one at a time, or say why it was withheld

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Telling.ScheduleRecurring
bridge_functions.description: Show one over and over, or say why it was withheld

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Telling.Cancel
bridge_functions.description: Take one back, whether it is showing, scheduled or neither

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Telling.CancelAll
bridge_functions.description: Take back everything this application scheduled

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Telling.ClearBadge
bridge_functions.description: Take the count off the application's icon

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Telling.Standing
bridge_functions.description: What the operator has already said about notifications, read without asking

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Telling.Ask
bridge_functions.description: Raise the notification prompt, record that it was raised, and answer what they said

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Scanning.Read
bridge_functions.description: Open the camera and read one pairing code, or say why nothing was read

info_plist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: lemonfiber talks to your stack on your own network. It does not send anything anywhere else.
info_plist.NSCameraUsageDescription: lemonfiber uses the camera once, to read the pairing code your stack is showing. Nothing it sees is stored or sent anywhere.
